moments.title: Premier League returns
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off this Friday, August 21st, with reigning champions Arsenal facing newly-promoted Coventry City in the opener.

angles.name: Season opener hype
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday with Arsenal starting their title defence. Who's your money on for the first goal?

angles.name: Fan anticipation
angles.copy: That Friday feeling just got better! The Premier League is back from August 21st. Get ready for a weekend of pure football action.

moments.title: Dutch Grand Prix
moments.blurb: Formula 1 heads to Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix this weekend, with practice starting Friday, August 21st, and the race on Sunday, August 23rd.

angles.name: Race weekend excitement
angles.copy: Lights out and away we go! The Dutch Grand Prix is this weekend. Who's taking the top step of the podium at Zandvoort?

angles.name: Driver focus
angles.copy: It's F1 race week! All eyes on Max Verstappen at his home Grand Prix. Can anyone stop him at Zandvoort?

moments.title: All Points East Festival
moments.blurb: All Points East returns to London's Victoria Park from August 21st to 30th, featuring headliners like Jorja Smith, Lorde, Deftones, and Tyler, The Creator.

angles.name: London festival buzz
angles.copy: All Points East kicks off this Friday in Victoria Park! Who are you most excited to see on the bill, from Jorja Smith to Tyler, The Creator?

angles.name: Lineup variety
angles.copy: From Lorde's atmospheric pop to Deftones' heavy riffs, All Points East has something for everyone starting this weekend. Get ready, London!

moments.title: Reading Festival
moments.blurb: Reading Festival takes over Richfield Avenue from August 27th-30th, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, RAYE, and Florence + The Machine.

angles.name: Festival countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until Reading Festival! Who's pitching their tent and getting ready for Charli XCX, Dave, and Florence + The Machine?

angles.name: Bank Holiday weekend plans
angles.copy: Your August Bank Holiday weekend plans are sorted! Reading Festival is just days away. What acts are top of your must-see list?

moments.title: Leeds Festival
moments.blurb: The twin to Reading, Leeds Festival brings the same huge lineup, including Charli XCX, Dave, RAYE, and Florence + The Machine, to Bramham Park from August 27th-30th.

angles.name: Leeds local hype
angles.copy: Leeds Festival is almost here! Bramham Park is about to come alive with Charli XCX, Dave, and so many more. Who's joining the party?

angles.name: Festival experience
angles.copy: Get ready for the biggest weekend in Yorkshire! Leeds Festival is just over a week away. Camping gear packed and playlists ready?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last long weekend of summer for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on August 29th-31st, marking a popular time for travel and outdoor events.

angles.name: Long weekend plans
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend is just around the corner! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer? Road trip, festival, or staycation?

angles.name: End of summer vibes
angles.copy: Make the most of it! The August Bank Holiday weekend (Aug 29-31) is the unofficial end of summer. How are you soaking up those last rays?
